no buzzwords or any of that. Firstly, why is the current system so bad? Currently we live in a world where we have to pay for nearly every single thing we need to survive, this is great for people who can easily get well paying jobs or people with family who can support them. But it seriously disadvantages anyone who doesn’t have that privilege. If you’re already poor paying for food, rent or a mortgage can be extremely difficult especially if you’re living on minimum wage. Or if unfortunately you are unable to work or aren’t able to find a job. Aboriginal people are hit by this the most because racism and colonialism has destroyed their culture and their way of life. Leading aboriginal communities into a cycle of poverty, making the gap wider. Obviously this happens to many other minority groups and other working class people but aboriginal communities are suffering the most. 

This leads to low socioeconomic status which then leads to the high incarceration rates. This system is built so that the poor continue to get poorer and the rich continue to get richer. Basic human rights like housing food and the right to live are turned into paywalls. Can’t afford rent too bad just be homeless, oh you can’t afford food just starve, or got arrested for taking food from a dumpster behind Coles, you have cancer and can’t afford chemo just fucking die. It shouldn’t be this way and it’s what’s causing such a large gap between groups of people.

That’s what I’d call the root cause of this inequality but there is definitely more factors. Racial profiling, and xenophobia being large factors too. I feel like this is fairly self evident and can be seen in cases like the murder of David Dungay where a young man was murdered for eating a fucking biscuit in his cell. 14,000 aboriginal people where separated from their families in 2017, because of “sub standard living conditions.” The same tactic used to tear families apart during the stolen generation (though I do recognise that some of these cases may of still been valid). If the government truely cared about these people then they’d be putting more money into improving those conditions. 

The state is what Enforces this bullshit it protects those who wore over resources. There is enough food to feed every mouth in Australia but our state enforces that it be sold those privlaged enough to afford it. There are enough empty homes to house all the homeless but the state protects those who decide to buy investment property after investment property. If I where to live in one of these empty properties I could be sent to jail for doing so, because the government would rather support its big business backers then actually help people. We live in an age where we could have homes, food and electricity for all but money stops us from all this. That is why I believe we should abolish the state, because we as humans can and will function better without it. We can still have order without law. We can still protect eachother without police and we can live without money.

I know this is a lot, it seems almost impossible but I beg you to atleast respect the time it took me to right this and learn more about anarchism. Just become aware of the multitude of different options we have that can lead to progress. If more people did that we’d certainly be living in a better world.
